logline: A woman cursed to die and be reborn across 600 years collides with an immortal man who stole her soul - and across centuries of reincarnation, their intertwined hatred and longing must finally resolve.

renewal.note: Single-season limited series. 16 episodes aired on tvN from December 18, 2021 to February 6, 2022. No sequel announced.

bollymeter.basis: A generously budgeted (approx. $33 million) supernatural thriller whose world-building and leads carry real weight, even when the 16-episode runtime strains the central mystery. Audience Popcornmeter on Rotten Tomatoes sat at 89%, reflecting strong fan enthusiasm for the reincarnation mythology.

seasons.review_body: Bulgasal: Immortal Souls arrived in late 2021 as one of Studio Dragon's most ambitious genre swings - a $33-million supernatural thriller spanning 600 years of reincarnation and vengeance. The show's lush production design and unusual decision to interweave Joseon-era flashbacks with a contemporary Seoul thriller were its most discussed formal qualities. Lee Jin-wook grounds the immortal bulgasal with quiet menace, and Kwon Nara handles the dual-timeline trauma with discipline. The series struggles in its middle stretch, where the mythology grows dense and forward momentum stalls. The 89% Rotten Tomatoes audience score reflects real enthusiasm for the show's mythological ambition. A rewarding binge for viewers willing to invest in the world-building.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 1
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The opener establishes the curse with visual sweep and a well-timed reveal of the two leads' cosmic entanglement. The production budget is immediately visible in the period sequences.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The first flash-cut between Joseon and modern Seoul that shows the same soul in two eras - the show's central gamble announced with confidence.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 16
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The finale closes the 600-year loop with earned emotional weight. Not all plot threads land cleanly, but the central relationship resolves on terms the show has been building toward from the first hour.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The final confrontation between the two leads reframes the series' opening image - a structural callback that rewards patient viewers.
